# The objects of `hod-meta-a598555f`, made by hod b701c7be (WP-129)

Made by hod at `b701c7be` (hod H-3: hod's own unit, producer 2, one kind 1
row `reloc-model`; release build), on an AArch64 host, 2026-11-17, from
the `.ll` files of `../hod-meta-a598555f/` with that README's command,
unchanged. Each object holds what the a598555f object holds, and hod's
88-byte unit (`reloc-model` = `static`) appended to the container hod
writes (`spec/meta.md` MT-20); for `alloc` (an allocated incoming
section) hod writes its unit in a `.mason.meta` section of its own.

`crates/mortar/tests/hod_meta.rs` `the_fixtures_are_hods` accepts a hod
that makes either directory's bytes; its other tests link the a598555f
objects.
